rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Go straight up these stairs to reach
Sachsum Gardens, the pride of the
capital, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0002
rows.name:
From there, you can go to Aquila
Watchtower or Aureus Palace, mo~.

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Traveling performers often play there
lately, making the gardens a place to
relax for everyone in the city, mo~.

rows.label: tlk70000045_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Ah! If the gate is closed, go around
through the shopping ward, mo~.
